notifications.heading: Planned network upgrade
notifications.bodyHtml: A planned network upgrade will take place on Monday 1 June from 19:00 to 23:00. We are expecting a small number of brief interruptions to the service during this window while the new network devices are installed and tested. If you need to work during this time, please save your work frequently.
